# 2026-09-25 — Counts Checkpoint

> Status: reviewed. Participants: Eli and Jo. Evidence: desk-close ledger totals.

## Method

Count a loan as matured only when its seven-day due date has passed the desk-close cutoff. A currently open loan with a later due date is not a late return. Use the [source ledger definition](../kb/pilot-metrics.md#collection-and-limitations) consistently.

## Observation

The first reminder batch is too small to attribute changes in return rates to the message. Keep the trial running and record whether a reminder was sent for each eligible matured loan.

## Actions

Eli will prepare a small aggregate extract for the [10 October metrics](../kb/pilot-metrics.md), without borrower names.
